en.headline: Mak outlines three-tier mechanism for building renovation disputes
en.dek: Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs Alice Mak said the planned system would involve district councillors first, then professional mediation, and finally the courts, with a target launch next year.
body: Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs Alice Mak Mei-kuen said on Saturday that a three-tier dispute resolution mechanism for building management issues, including major renovations, is planned for introduction next year.

Speaking on a radio programme, Mak said many disputes begin with differing opinions among neighbours that escalate when parties refuse to compromise, eventually reaching the Lands Tribunal and consuming time and money without improving management. She said the first tier would rely on district councillors’ experience and networks to arrange face-to-face meetings between residents, owners’ corporations and management companies at an early stage. Unresolved cases would be referred to the Home Affairs Department’s existing professional mediation schemes, with the third tier going to court.

Mak said district councillors would receive training in mediation skills and would continue to assist residents through the process if a case proceeds to court. She added that rational discussion among owners, corporations and consultants would strengthen oversight of major works, while a lack of unity could allow unscrupulous traders to take advantage. The mechanism follows heightened attention to building management after the November 2025 fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po, which killed 168 people during a major renovation.

Authorities are also preparing further amendments to the Building Management Ordinance. These include requiring briefings before votes on major works, measures to improve the authenticity of proxy votes, and stronger interest-declaration rules for consultants and contractors.

zh.headline: 麥美娟：明年推三層機制處理大廈管理糾紛
zh.dek: 民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟表示，計劃明年推行三層調解機制，先由區議員介入，再轉介專業調解，最終才交法庭處理，以改善包括大維修在內的大廈管理。
body: 民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟周六在電台節目表示，政府計劃明年推出處理大廈管理糾紛的三層機制，涵蓋大維修等事宜。
麥美娟指，不少爭議源於鄰里初期意見分歧，其後因各不相讓演變成對簿公堂，耗費時間金錢卻無助改善管理。第一層會由區議員憑經驗和地區網絡，主動安排居民、法團或管理公司面對面開會，及早處理具體問題；若未能解決，則轉介民政事務總署現有的三個義務專業調解計劃；第三層才交由土地審裁處等法庭裁決。
她說，當局會為區議員提供調解技巧培訓，不少區議員認為安排合適，因日常工作亦想協助街坊；若個案最終需上法庭，區議員亦會協助不熟悉手續的居民填表，全程跟進。麥美娟強調，若業主、法團和顧問能理性討論，必能加強大廈管理和監察；反之，若不能團結理性處理，不法商人便有機可乘。機制提出，是在大埔宏福苑去年11月大火造成168人死亡、涉及大型維修工程後，社會關注樓宇管理的背景下進行。
政府亦正籌備進一步修訂《建築物管理條例》，包括大維修投票前強制舉辦簡介會、確保授權票真確性的措施，以及加強顧問公司與承辦商的利益申報機制。
